Pairs on diagonal · suited above · offsuit below. Darker cells have higher values. Dashed cells have fewer than 20 personal opportunities or 5 population reveals. Click a hand for counts and differences. ? means unknown. Source draft zeros mean no aggressive action supplied, not necessarily fold.

Source and export methodology

Authored charts retain their original draft weights. All 111 entries are imported, including not-applicable placeholders. ACR opening and 3-bet drafts use different published 100bb proxies with editorial weights; live and straddled entries are manual hypotheses. None is a solved equilibrium baseline.

New comparisons use only six-handed 25NL Blitz data. Three-bet comparisons match the original opener and exclude prior limpers and intervening cold callers. Effective stacks and raise sizes still vary. Historical mixed-stakes charts remain separately browsable.

Personal percentages are action/opportunity counts for each class. Population percentages use revealed action hands plus a weak personal-shape prior, calibrated to all observed action counts. Reveals are biased; low-sample cards can be misleading. No reveal correction is applied by default because the earlier temporal diagnostic did not support it.

Pio needs range weights rather than a conditional action strategy. Authored exports preserve their supplied weights. Personal exports use observed action counts per combination, scaled so the largest weight is 1; missing action classes receive zero in that empirical composition, without proving they are never played. Population exports use the modeled action composition per combination, similarly scaled. Pooled 4-bet and VPIP exports are exploratory and do not define a complete postflop matchup. Suits within a class have equal weights. Choose both players, stacks, board and sizing separately before solving.

Text syntax is matched to the installed Pio range files and round-trip checked. A Pio GUI import has not been verified.

Offline library · no database credentials or live database connection · source snapshot September 2026 · database hands end September 2025. Personal ranges are anonymized study observations.
